purpose: Agent-readable index of architecture decisions that explain why current NaC domain guardrails exist.

decisions.title: Matter visibility is bound to the assigned notary team
decisions.summary: The MVP uses a private Microsoft 365 Team and SharePoint site per notary team. Matters reference the responsible team and assigned people instead of being visible to all notary-office users.

decisions.title: Deputy access is a timeboxed exception with reason and audit correlation
decisions.summary: Deputy access is modeled through Vertretungsfreigaben with reason, validity window, approver, status and audit correlation. Permanent or unreasoned deputy grants are outside the MVP boundary.

decisions.title: Graph REST request plans precede owner-gated live writes
decisions.summary: The domain flow stays Graph REST v1.0 only. Offline request plans, readiness checks and redacted evidence must pass before any owner-gated live write path is used.

decisions.title: Apply live-smoke is a separate owner-gated release lane
decisions.summary: The real matter-access apply smoke writes and deletes synthetic SharePoint list items, so it is not a silent default in the one-shot release gate. It requires explicit owner approval and is attached to release-gate evidence only via an explicit artifact path.

decisions.title: Apply live-smoke evidence is retained by correlation ID
decisions.summary: A PASSED owner-gated matter-access apply live smoke must archive its redacted artifact into a correlation-based local retention folder and update a local searchable retention index before the command itself returns PASSED.

decisions.title: Microsoft-first edge with on-prem AI and durable workflow core
decisions.summary: Teams, SPFx, SharePoint, Entra and Graph REST v1.0 form the user, identity and data edge; Python/FastAPI, deterministic workflows, NVIDIA NeMo Agent Toolkit, PostgreSQL, outbox/broker and WORM remain on-prem. Temporal is an outcome-open timeboxed spike candidate only.

decisions.title: BusinessCaseTypeId validity is viewer-independent
decisions.summary: Canonical business-case type validity depends on the repository catalog and the minimal Vorgangsartenregister projection, never on Prozessregister, BPMN models or viewer availability.

decisions.title: CatalogVersion is a content identity and runtime lifecycle is explicit
decisions.summary: CatalogVersion is derived from canonical catalog content. Inventory schema versions, timestamps and planning source status do not authorize runtime lifecycle or matter selection.

decisions.title: Aliases are purpose-bound and cache revalidation fails closed
decisions.summary: Canonical assignment rejects aliases. Legacy read and migration may resolve one direct alias with audit-required evidence. Cache age never authorizes a mutation after the five-minute revalidation boundary.

decisions.title: Graph read edge is exact-scope, complete and locally compared
decisions.summary: The S4 adapter uses Graph REST v1.0 GET only with exactly Sites.Selected and an existing site grant role read. Every next link preserves the same-filter bound site, list, projection, BusinessCaseTypeId filter and CatalogVersion filter; row ETags are compared locally after a complete read and are never sent as collection If-None-Match. Redaction and viewer isolation remain mandatory; S4b writes stay open and excluded.
